rationale: Competing selection is explicit, but current frozen/source metadata does not establish that the competing pressures are pollinator and antagonist effects on one common trait-fitness coefficient scale.
The dissertation explicitly targets herbivore- and pollinator-mediated selection on floral display, but exact gradients/uncertainty are not materialized in SCH.

Brassica rapa herbivory-volatiles-pollinator-fitness study is biologically relevant, but independence from the existing Brassica 000775 selection programme is not established and the title does not itself provide a commensurate selection coefficient.
